desc:
TABASCO FLAVORED BUGLES: The cheesy Bugles Crispy Corn Snacks you know and love with the flavor of Tabasco Brand Pepper Sauce; The ultimate hot and cheesy snack

PANTRY AND PARTY FAVORITE: A pantry staple that's delicious alone or added to your favorite party snack mix recipes; Fun-shaped alternative to ordinary chips

ON THE GO SNACKS: Perfect for the lunchbox or a grab and go snack as you head out the door

ENDLESS OPTIONS: Tasty for both kids and kids at heart, look to Bugles recipes for all kinds of creative ways to enjoy this unique snack

CONTAINS: One 7.5 oz bag of Bugles Tabasco Flavored Crispy Corn Snacks; About 7 servings per bag
features:
Features:

Crunchy Cone Shape

Classic Bugles shape—fun to eat, great for dipping, and a nostalgic favorite.

Spicy Tabasco Flavor

Coated in bold Tabasco pepper seasoning, delivering a tangy, zesty, and slightly hot flavor.

Crispy Corn Snack

Made from cornmeal and fried to create a light, crunchy texture.

Ready-to-Eat Convenience

Available in snack-size or larger family packs—perfect for any occasion.

No Peanuts

Produced in a peanut-free facility (though it contains milk and may contain wheat).

Benefits:

Exciting Taste

Offers a spicy twist on a classic snack with the unmistakable taste of Tabasco.

Great for Sharing or Solo Snacking

Ideal for lunchboxes, road trips, game nights, or just a flavorful treat at home.

Satisfying Crunch

Crisp texture makes it a fun and enjoyable snack experience.

Nostalgic Fun

A familiar snack reinvented with bold flavor—enjoyed by both kids and adults.
ingredients: Degermed Yellow Corn Meal, Coconut Oil, Sugar. Contains 2% or less of: Corn Maltodextrin, Salt, Whey Powder, Monosodium Glutamate, Natural Flavor, Distilled Monoglycerides, Baking Soda, Garlic Powder, Color (paprika extract, turmeric extract), Spice, Malic Acid, TABASCO® Brand Flavoring (red pepper, distilled vinegar, salt), Sunflower Oil, Dried Buttermilk, Palm Oil, Yeast Extract, TABASCO® Brand Seasoning (TABASCO® Brand Pepper Sauce [distilled vinegar, red pepper, salt], maltodextrin), Onion Powder. Freshness Preserved by BHT.
